title: Dothan United Dragons Secure Playoff Spot with 2-0 Win Over Apotheos FC
text:
The Dothan United Dragons clinched a consecutive USL League 2 Playoffs berth after a 2-0 road victory against Apotheos FC. Goals from Ryan Holmes and Oskar Kaufmann in the second half secured the win, improving Dothan's record to 13-1-2 overall and 8-1-2 in the USL2 South Central Division. Apotheos FC fell to 2-6-3 in division play.
DECATUR, Ga. - The Dothan United Dragons checked off a very important point on their checklist on Wednesday night out in the metro Atlanta area, as they punched their ticket for a second year in a row to the USL League 2 Playoffs after a 2-0 road win over Apotheos FC.
In the first of two meetings this week against the team from Dekalb County, Georgia, DUSC handled an important and necessary piece of business, overcoming some missed opportunities and pressure in a scoreless first half to find their rally in the final 45 minutes of play. The first of the scoring for the Dragons came in the 64th minute, when a beautiful cross from Josh Hallenberger found the head of Ryan Holmes in the box right in front of the goal, as he sent it into the top left corner of the goal past the Locomotives goalie to finally break a 0-0 tie that held through the majority of this contest.
Then, for an extra bit of cushion just 4 minutes of play later, DUSC took advantage of a poorly tapped away cross into the box that went over to Oskar Kaufmann, who sent a dribbler past the keeper to extend the lead out to where it would go final another 22 minutes later. The victory in enemy territory pushed Dothan to a 13-1-2 overall record for the 2026 regular season and 8-1-2 in USL2 South Central Division play.
The loss for Apotheos drop them to 2-6-3 on the year in division play. With the win, DUSC now sits at 26 points in the league table, ranking 2nd at present just under Southern Soccer Academy’s Swarm FC, who also got to 26 points on Wednesday with a win over East Atlanta.
Presently, Swarm hold the tiebreaker over Dothan United based on their 3-1 win over the Dragons on June 28, but with the Austell, Georgia squad wrapping up their league schedule on Wednesday, DUSC will enter their Saturday night return match against Apotheos needing either a win or a tie to secure the team’s first division crown to coincide with a second straight postseason trip in just their third season of existence. The weekend clash against the Locomotives will kickoff at 7 p.m. central from Rip Hewes Stadium in Dothan.
